'''Patrick Booth''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[February 2001 Williston Park tournament]] on 22 February 2001, according to Morgan Dunn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1768">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-williston-park-ny-2-22-01d1768/ williston-park-ny-2-22-01], DeckTech (Morgan "jamorg247" Dunn, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-williston-park-ny-2-22-01d1768/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
